We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template that was result of task make_6_lvl2-template_search-2 to the molecule given (the SMILES from make_6_lvl2-apply_template-1). However template_search-2 failed. We need to find appropriate template. The description: Friedel-Crafts acylation retrosynthesis: target molecule is given: COc1ccc(CNc2c(C(=O)Nc3cccc(OC)c3)nnn2Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)cc1

We need to apply a template that corresponds to Friedel-Crafts acylation (forward: acyl chloride + aromatic -> aryl ketone, breaking C-Cl bond). In retrosynthesis, we break the C-C bond between aromatic ring and carbonyl carbon, generating an acyl chloride (or acid chloride) and aromatic ring.

We need to find a template ID that matches this transformation. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken=["halide"]? Actually forward reaction breaks halide (C-Cl) and forms carbonyl attached to aromatic (C-C bond formed, C=O formed). So functional_groups_broken includes "halide". functional_groups_formed maybe "ketone"? Not sure list. Could try search with bonds_broken=["C-Cl"], bonds_formed=["C-C","C=O"].

Let's attempt search.
